    fn build_cidr_block_associations_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::provider_populated("cidr_block_associations", AttributeType::unordered_list(AttributeType::string_member(crate::schemas::string_identity::StringIdentity::Ec2VpcCidrBlockAssociationId.identity_layer(), carina_core::schema::StringMemberConstraints::new(None, None))))
                .with_description(" (read-only)")
                .with_provider_name("CidrBlockAssociations")
            .build()
    }
    fn build_enum_modes_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::optional("enum_modes", AttributeType::map_with_key(AttributeType::refined_string(None, Some(carina_core::schema::PatternSpec::new(".*", carina_core::schema::PatternMatch::Full)), None, None), AttributeType::enum_(carina_core::schema::enum_identity("EnumModes", Some("aws.ec2.Vpc")), Some(vec!["enabled".to_string(), "disabled".to_string()]), vec![("enabled".to_string(), "enabled".to_string()), ("disabled".to_string(), "disabled".to_string())], None, None)))
                .with_provider_name("EnumModes")
            .build()
    }
    fn build_modes_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::optional("modes", AttributeType::map_with_key(AttributeType::refined_string(None, Some(carina_core::schema::PatternSpec::new(".*", carina_core::schema::PatternMatch::Full)), None, None), AttributeType::refined_string(None, Some(carina_core::schema::PatternSpec::new("^[a-z]+$", carina_core::schema::PatternMatch::Full)), Some((Some(1), Some(256))), None)))
                .with_provider_name("Modes")
            .build()
    }
    fn build_ratio_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::optional("ratio", AttributeType::float())
                .with_provider_name("Ratio")
            .build()
    }
    fn build_tags_attribute() -> AttributeSchema {
        AttributeSchema::optional("tags", AttributeType::map_with_key(AttributeType::string(), AttributeType::string()))
                .with_description("The tags for the VPC.")
                .with_provider_name("Tags")
                .with_block_name("tag")
            .build()
    }
